notes.title: Half-Life. 498 (KZ&UK)
notes.notes:
[p][i]! This event is not related to our game Critical Shift ![/i][/p][p]Rhinotales was honored to support and partially fund the sound performance in the city of Karaganda.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/7796e83a86e25dd7306589279273e9b05dd1b1a9.jpg"][/img]
On July 12, a powerful and emotional sound-art performance titled [b]"T 1/2 (Time of Half-Life)"[/b] took place in Karaganda, dedicated to the [i][u]memory of nuclear testing at the Semipalatinsk Test Site.[/u][/i][/p][p]The number 498 refers to the [b]498[/b] nuclear explosions conducted there between 1949 and 1989 - one of the gravest and least acknowledged human-made disasters of the 20th century. [/p][p]Artists Kamila Narysheva (kz) and Vicki Clarke (uk) created the work after a research trip to the former test site. Kamila expected desolation, but instead found a paradox: contaminated, restricted land coexisting with wild, living nature.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/8a7388a16997a1045e55c4421df098b5131303b6.jpg"][/img]
The piece opens with real sounds from the site  a dog barking, snow crunching raw echoes from a haunted landscape.[/p][p]At school, many of us were briefly told about a test site and shown disturbing images.[/p][p]Then we turned the page.[/p][p]Few of us grasped the true scale.[/p][p]Hiroshima and Nagasaki - 2 bombs.[/p][p]Semipalatinsk - 498.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/c763e018f977560a003bbf20fa16ba41c57bd3a6.jpg"][/img]
Some of our own team at Rhinotales have family roots in nearby regions - 80 to 130 km from the epicenter.[/p][p]People were told: [i]“Lie down, cover yourself with a felt carpet (koshma), and when the wind dies down, you can get up.”[/i][/p][p]And they obeyed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/89d51eb3d79a7b2b75b90bd55cbf6152316e5efa.jpg"][/img]
This is not just a story for those in Semey.[/p][p]It is part of our shared past, our collective responsibility, and a legacy we must acknowledge if we hope to move forward.[/p][p]“While working on this piece, Vicki Clarke hadn’t initially considered the UK’s role. Britain didn’t test on its own land. It tested in Australia far away. But it was involved.”[/p][p]Nuclear tests conducted:[/p][p]UK – 45[/p][p]France – 210[/p][p]China – 45[/p][p]USSR – 715[/p][p]USA – 1,054

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/fec9f73888bbbe15388f383142f7ab4b2ffb7608.jpg"][/img]
We chose to support this performance not because it's related to our game, but because it took place in our country, and because it speaks to something much deeper.[/p][p]Art can give voice to silence, and remembrance to tragedy.[/p][p]We are grateful to the artists and everyone who attended.
[/p][p][b]Let us remember and protect what remains.[/b][/p]

notes.title: New Screenshots
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone! We’re excited to share some new screenshots from across our levels!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/f4a0da0fecf52e5a23d9f58047cd6426f2e5741b.png"][/img]
In this scene, you’re getting a first look at one of the game’s most intriguing - and still under wraps - features: the bosses. Each boss is unique, with its own strengths, weaknesses, and occasionally very specific battle mechanics. We can’t reveal much yet about this creature, but check out how its massive tentacle greets our approaching agents![/p][p]Below, you’ll find more screenshots. First, a quick update: it’s a scorching summer out there, but rest assured, our brains haven’t melted - we’re hard at work on Critical Shift, step by step. The game is large and complex, and several systems still need fine‑tuning and testing before we can share them in closed beta. Thanks so much for your patience and support![/p][p]Stay tuned - and don’t forget to join our Discord and follow us on social media. There’s a lot more coming on gameplay mechanics, story, and the world!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/be2ff6596ae42c50ebbd1551c1d46c2dfc13e3b2.png"][/img]
The pair of oversized hands you see hides a secret as big as the owner behind them.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/72fd2a1e151090d54aef92b7cd12aea0927552c9.png"][/img]
Yes - there are explosives in the game.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/2aaa33463f614e353d2e728bfeb442cd0668b240.png"][/img]
These EXO HIVE species seem to be guarding the altar in the background. Why is it so important?
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/db5a2371b3657cc37b199011a16e0332cefd18e4.png"][/img]
Stillness in the cave garden, following a grueling fight.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/11da23b0e3f00a6791a59bd17b4a4c11b06b6171.png"][/img]
Some battles happen in peculiar places; this museum is one, steeped in the mysterious history of our civilization.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/b3a8ea272958af6373371e0bc7f82cfea5d1b257.png"][/img]
And of course it’s Antarctica - deep beneath its icy surface, truly strange things could be hidden.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Rhinotales at Comic Con Astana 2025!
notes.notes:
[p]On July 10, our team at Rhinotales, represented by Artyom Slessarenko, had the pleasure of participating in Comic Con Astana 2025, where we presented our game Critical Shift.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627889/12dddce6eeab9e381604cd5a897a308dbd7e62ac.jpg"][/img]
We hosted an AMA session, shared insights about the gameplay, world, and inspiration behind the project  and had a great live conversation with the audience. [/p][p]It was incredibly rewarding to see genuine interest in the game - people stopped by, asked questions, shared thoughts. Many joined our socials to follow the development, and quite a few added Critical Shift to their Steam wishlists to stay updated on upcoming news and playtests![/p][p]A big thank you to everyone who came over, supported us, or just took a moment to listen. Events like this truly energize and remind us we’re on the right track.[/p][p]Much more ahead — news, milestones, content and surprises. Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Thank you
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Since announcing Critical Shift, we've been thrilled to see your reactions! Thank you so much for your attention, thoughtful questions, good wishes, and kind words. It genuinely means a lot to us and brings with it a huge responsibility to meet your expectations. Seeing your sincere enthusiasm for the genre and atmosphere, as well as your mentions of the games that inspire us - it's truly a joy to share this virtual space with you!

Our goal is to deliver an incredible hardcore tactics experience, combined with atmospheric real-time exploration and woven through with a deeply dramatic storyline filled with dread and mystery. We're listening closely to what you want - and trust us, we're cooking something special!

To ensure we get it right, we're going to cook this dish together with you. Before the official beta on Steam later this year, we're planning several smaller-scale tests with a rougher version of the game, allowing us to refine the battle system with your valuable feedback.

If you're interested in participating, our Discord is the best place to keep an eye out for updates. It's also a fantastic space to join our community, ask questions, and talk directly with us about the game.

Stay tuned - and thank you again!

Rhinotales

notes.title: We’re announcing Critical Shift
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=-Gy9umYo748;full]https://youtu.be/-Gy9umYo748[/previewyoutube]

In the trailer, you’ll see gameplay footage, a glimpse of the mysterious atmosphere, and the first strokes of the story we want to tell.
We’ve prepared this gameplay preview so you can already get a sense of the direction the project is taking.
Please note: this is a work in progress — both visuals and gameplay will receive significant improvements as we move closer to release.

Critical Shift is a hardcore turn-based tactical game with RPG elements and a dramatic storyline.
We’re putting everything we have into it: experience, energy, and our love for the genre. We hope that comes through.
Your support — especially by adding the game to your Steam wishlist — means a lot to us.

A few words from the team:
We’ve been working on Critical Shift for several years. It’s the result of long and continuous effort.
Our goal is to create a game we truly want to play ourselves. We've tried to include everything we believe matters, and add the things we've always felt were missing in tactical games.
If what we’re building resonates with you, we’d love to have you follow the game’s development.
